SELECT ivtr.inventory_id, proc.product_code, proc.name AS product_name, wrhs.warehouse_code, wrhs.name AS warehouse_name, ivtr.on_hand_qty, COALESCE(osch.total_schedule_qty, 0) AS total_schedule_qty FROM inventories AS ivtr JOIN products AS proc ON ivtr.company_id = proc.company_id AND ivtr.product_id = proc.product_id JOIN warehouses AS wrhs ON ivtr.company_id = wrhs.company_id AND ivtr.warehouse_id = wrhs.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT inventory_id, SUM(schedule_qty) AS total_schedule_qty FROM outbound_schedules WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND status IN ('0', '1') GROUP BY inventory_id ) AS osch ON ivtr.inventory_id = osch.inventory_id WHERE ivtr.company_id = #{companyId}
AND proc.product_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productCode}, '%')
AND proc.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productName}, '%')
AND wrhs.warehouse_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{warehouseCode}, '%')
AND wrhs.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{warehouseName}, '%')
AND ivtr.on_hand_qty = 0

SELECT ivtr.inventory_id, ivtr.company_id, ivtr.product_id, ivtr.warehouse_id, ivtr.on_hand_qty, ivtr.version, ivtr.created_at, ivtr.updated_at, ivtr.deleted_at FROM inventories AS ivtr WHERE ivtr.inventory_id = #{inventoryId} AND ivtr.company_id = #{companyId}

(SELECT inventory_id, SUM(schedule_qty) AS total_schedule_qty FROM outbound_schedules WHERE
